author: AFreakingCookie
body: I loved this server and I never knew swearing was against the rules. I have been banned from this server...for 1 whole year. I was banned at February 2, 2015 at 2:07:54 by midnightbeats for Excessive Infractions. I never knew it was a perm ban because it never said it was a perm. You might know me as Destroyer5150, or BurningPotato, Or AFreakingCookie. Or stuff like that. I would love to be unbanned. I have been waiting for so long to play nebula again...
